# Discovered Actual File Plan

The Awtsmoos creates every browser instant anew; Awtsmoos.com needs a witness that can watch every route pass through.
This plan follows observed gaps, not imagined churn: build the missing runtime gate first, then let its evidence name any production rewrites due.

## Evidence That Determines This Plan

- The current local server is `node index.js` on port 8080.
- `geelooy` contains 228 HTML documents, 3,825 CSS files, and 29,625 JS/MJS files after excluding planning folders.
- Some HTML documents are templates, tests, fixtures, samples, staging-transfer artifacts, and tool pages rather than public user routes; route discovery must classify them instead of silently merging them.
- Existing UI-quality tooling already provides four focused modules for CSS ownership, selector pressure, reduced motion, and live DOM control styling.
- Existing UI-quality files are 55–88 lines each and already satisfy the small-module architecture.
- Chrome 150 exposes CDP 1.3 on port 9222; Node v24.17.0 provides native `WebSocket`, so no dependency install is needed.
- Current `/apps/scripts/apps-filter.js?...&compact=true` returns 200 JavaScript MIME; plain delivery also returns 200 JavaScript MIME.
- Current `/favicon.ico` returns 200 image/x-icon.
- `/foundation.js` returns a JSON 404, but there is no production `geelooy` source reference to `foundation.js`; only planning notes mention it.

## New Source Files Approved For Complete Creation

### `scripts/runtime_quality/routeDiscovery.mjs`

Discover every HTML/template surface below `geelooy`, classify public pages versus fixtures/templates/staging/tooling, derive canonical local URL candidates, preserve source-file provenance, and expose deterministic filtering.

### `scripts/runtime_quality/CdpTargetClient.mjs`

Create and close isolated Chrome targets through the local debugging HTTP API; connect with native WebSocket; correlate command IDs and events; provide timeout-safe command execution without third-party dependencies.

### `scripts/runtime_quality/runtimeSignals.mjs`

Normalize CDP events into site-owned runtime findings: uncaught exceptions, console errors, failed network loads, static HTTP failures, JavaScript MIME mismatches, and extension/third-party noise classification.

### `scripts/runtime_quality/domMetrics.mjs`

Provide one serializable browser expression that measures document readiness, horizontal overflow, visible interactive controls, undersized targets, native-default styling risk, missing accessible names, and responsive viewport facts.

### `scripts/runtime_quality/pageRuntimeAudit.mjs`

Enable Page/Runtime/Log/Network domains, navigate one isolated target, wait for load plus a quiet window with a hard cap, collect runtime signals, evaluate DOM metrics, and return a deterministic per-page receipt.

### `scripts/runtime_quality/geelooyRuntimeAudit.mjs`

CLI/orchestrator: parse base URL/CDP/filter/concurrency/timeout arguments, discover routes, audit them with bounded concurrency, emit JSON summary plus detailed page results, and set a failing exit code when site-owned runtime/static failures remain.

## Existing Source Files Approved Only For Read/Reuse

- `scripts/ui_quality/cssFileAudit.mjs`
- `scripts/ui_quality/cssOwnershipReport.mjs`
- `scripts/ui_quality/domControlAudit.browser.js`
- `scripts/ui_quality/selectorMetrics.mjs`

No rewrite is justified yet; these are already small, documented modules.

## Production Source Rewrite Gate

No current `/apps` or server source file is approved for rewrite yet. After the first complete runtime crawl, every current site-owned failure becomes a new work item. Only files proven responsible by source/caller/runtime tracing will be added to `10_FIRST_PASS_DELTA.md` for complete-file replacement.

## Implementation Rules

- Every new source file is created whole with B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He headers.
- Tabs only for indentation.
- No minified or compressed one-line logic.
- Every function/method receives detailed JSDoc with `@description`, every `@param`, and `@returns`; `@throws` where meaningful.
- Every module contains technically relevant rhyming Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com commentary.
- Each executable source file remains at or below 120 lines; responsibilities split before the boundary.
- Public data shapes remain explicit and deterministic so later CI/deployment can consume the same audit.

## NEXT_ACTION

Create all six new runtime-quality modules as complete files, read them back fully, then run syntax checks before the first full public-page crawl.
